Write a launch announcement for our new budgeting app, Penny. The audience is first-time savers in their twenties who find spreadsheets intimidating. Keep it short and engaging, highlight the three core features (auto-categorised spending, weekly goals, shared pots with a partner), and end with a clear call to action to join the waitlist before March 1. Avoid jargon, don't mention competitors, and make sure every statistic you include can be sourced from the 2025 user survey. The marketing lead will review the draft before it goes out, so flag anything you are unsure about.
